subject: Polynomial Regression and Response Surface Analysis With SEM and Lavaan

messages.author: 556685e17a412579
messages.subject: Polynomial Regression and Response Surface Analysis With SEM and Lavaan
parts:
Hi all!

I am interested in running a model testing the effect of congruence in choices between two people. I found that the more reliable method to explore that is polynomial regression followed by response surface analysis.

I am not familiar with the technique in general, but I would like to ask if you know any paper that has used SEM output (instead of regression outputs) to do response surface analysis.

Thanks a lot!
John

messages.author: bfa43814f6ba1969
messages.subject: Re: Polynomial Regression and Response Surface Analysis With SEM and Lavaan
parts:
John,

 

Here is one example:

 

https://doi.org/10.1145/3410977.3410981

 

Not the best article ever, but it was the first one that came to my mind because I am one of the authors. Response surface analysis does not care if the coefficients that you feed into it came from regression with observed variables or from a latent variable regression.

 

I am attaching the R code that we used to do the response surface plot from Mplus results.

 

Mikko
